name: Gran Melia Colon
insider_take: A palatial Belle Époque masterpiece where Seville's aristocratic heritage meets modern luxury in the heart of the historic center.
whats_special: This 1928 architectural gem was built as a grand hotel for the Ibero-American Exposition and has hosted royalty, celebrities, and dignitaries for nearly a century. The hotel's stunning neoclassical facade and opulent interiors showcase original marble columns, crystal chandeliers, and hand-painted ceilings that transport guests to Seville's golden age.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the hotel's interior courtyard for the most serene experience, or request a street-facing room to watch the daily processions during Semana Santa from your balcony.
dont_miss: The hotel sits just steps from the iconic Seville Cathedral and Giralda Tower - you can walk to these UNESCO World Heritage sites in under 3 minutes. The nearby Alcázar Palace, with its breathtaking Mudéjar architecture and gardens, is also within easy walking distance, making this the perfect base for exploring Seville's most treasured monuments.
pros: Prime location in historic Seville city center
Elegant colonial architecture with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional rooftop terrace with panoramic city views
Outstanding personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Historic building constraints may limit some room configurations
